title: Protected Workflow Authorization
description: Per-PR, defense-in-depth declaration that a change to one or more PROTECTED CI workflow paths (the pytest protected-path drift guard's _PROTECTED_WORKFLOW_PATHS set, e.g. .github/workflows/test.yml) is deliberate and cross-provider reviewed. This artifact is the input the pytest drift guard (tests/test_support_matrix_smoke_workflow.py) recognizes so an authorized, narrow, fresh protected-workflow change passes while accidental drift still fails closed. It is NOT the merge authority: the real high-risk merge authority remains ao-release-gate (HIGH_RISK_PATH_PATTERNS + supersession / non-author human review) plus the GitHub ruleset. The guard requires this file to be (re)written in the SAME PR that touches a protected workflow (freshness: a stale main-state authorization grants no standing) and to list EXACTLY the protected workflow paths changed (narrowness). It authorizes additions/modifications only; protected-workflow deletions and renames are unconditionally fail-closed and cannot be authorized here. It cannot authorize .github/rulesets or .github/branch-protection. No secret material may appear in any field.

work_package.description: Work-package identifier for the PR that carries the protected-workflow change. Same canonical regex used across the repo's evidence artifacts.

reason.description: Short human-readable justification for the protected-workflow change. No secret material.

items.description: A protected CI workflow path this PR is authorized to add or modify. Must be a member of the drift guard's _PROTECTED_WORKFLOW_PATHS set (enforced by the consuming test, single source of truth).

authorized_paths.description: Exactly the set of protected workflow paths added/modified in this PR. The drift guard rejects any protected-workflow change not listed here (missing) and any listed path not changed in this PR (over-broad).

items.description: Repo-relative path to a cross-provider review evidence artifact backing this authorization (e.g. local-ai-review-evidence.v1.json).

review_evidence_refs.description: Audit pointers to the cross-AI review evidence that backs this authorization. The pytest guard does not parse these (the real high-risk review authority is ao-release-gate); they exist for human/audit traceability.
